Description: Accessible QuickPOS branding, desktop navigation, mobile navigation and Sign Up CTA.
Product value proposition, calls to action and original illustrative POS dashboard.
Required Inventory, Analytics, Customers and Integrations feature presentation.
Illustrative Basic, Pro and Enterprise plans with functional contact CTAs.
Accessible PHP POST contact flow, server validation and accurate confirmation.
Copyright, meaningful navigation and explicit social placeholders.
Automated validation tests, PHP lint, responsive QA, CI and evidence.
As a visitor I can use desktop navigation. Acceptance: logo visible; Features/Pricing/Contact targets exist; Sign Up reaches Contact; keyboard focus is visible.
As a mobile visitor I can open and close navigation. Acceptance: menu toggles; aria-expanded changes; Escape returns focus; link click closes menu; no overflow.
As a visitor I understand the QuickPOS value proposition. Acceptance: required headline/subcopy appear; Get Started reaches Contact; Explore Features reaches Features.

Summary: POS mockup presents credible sample data
Description: As a visitor I can inspect a credible POS dashboard. Acceptance: custom HTML/CSS/SVG visual; sales/stock/analytics represented; data labelled illustrative; responsive.
As a visitor I see four core features. Acceptance: Inventory, Analytics, Customers and Integrations each have an icon, title and benefit.
As a maintainer I have clear PHP entry points. Acceptance: public/src separation; reusable validateContact contract; local PHP server starts without warnings.
As a visitor I can compare Basic, Pro and Enterprise. Acceptance: illustrative price/benefits visible; Pro highlighted; each CTA reaches Contact with selected plan; no billing.
As a visitor I can submit Name Email and Message. Acceptance: associated labels; POST method; submit control; plan context preserved.
As a visitor I see accurate validation. Acceptance: empty name/message and invalid email rejected; field errors and summary shown; safe values retained; HTTP 422.

Summary: Valid contact input receives honest confirmation
Description: As a visitor I receive confirmation. Acceptance: valid POST redirects with 303; one-time page; no false email or persistent-storage claim; refresh cannot replay success.
As a visitor I can navigate from the footer. Acceptance: copyright; site/product links; social placeholders explicitly identified.
As a maintainer I have automated validation tests. Acceptance: at least four required cases; edge cases; any failure exits nonzero; command documented.
As a maintainer I have CI. Acceptance: required branch/PR triggers; Ubuntu/PHP; all PHP linted; tests run; any error fails; main green.
As a visitor I can use the page at 375 768 and 1280 pixels. Acceptance: no horizontal overflow; CTAs work; browser has no console/page errors.
As an evaluator I can reproduce and inspect the project. Acceptance: README run/test steps; actual links; evidence inventory; contributor disclosure; no placeholders presented as facts.
